message.content: no lane briefs given. /ultrathink-swarm usage: `/ultrathink-swarm <brief>|<brief>|…` spawns one AgentSwarm orchestrator lane per brief (up to 6 per command). Swarm drops briefs its classifier does not read as SDLC work, so those are refused up front. `/ultrathink-swarm status` reports each lane as planning, running, skipped, plan-failed, done, attention or not-planned; `/ultrathink-swarm stop [laneId|all]` ends a lane's process group. A lane's real output is autonomous.log, events.jsonl and results/ in its state dir (<state dir>/swarm/<lane>/); run.log there is only the wrapper's own stdout. ULTRATHINK_SWARM_MAX_LANES (default 3, cap 6) bounds live lanes across all commands, and a brief already running in the same repository is refused; two lanes in one repository share one working tree and its branches. Lanes are detached on purpose: ending the Omp session does not stop them. Configuration is env-only: ULTRATHINK_SWARM_ROOT (or SWARM_ROOT) names the absolute agent-swarm checkout (required).
AgentSwarm lanes unavailable: ULTRATHINK_SWARM_ROOT (or SWARM_ROOT fallback) is not set — point one of them at an absolute agent-swarm checkout
